summary: ```# Marvelous Designer Quick Start Tutorial ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore the quick start panel creation process in Marvelous Designer, featuring a Chinese voiceover and subtitles. ## Accessing the Virtual Model 1. In the library window, find the file folder containing the virtual model. 2. Open the search bar for the virtual model to match it. 3. After entering the virtual model, we will utilize the linear virtual model tool to draw and remove the whiteboard on the model. ## Creating Starting Points 1. Click on the model to create a starting point. 2. During the drawing process, press the **Ctrl** key and click on the model to establish a starting point. 3. Release the **Ctrl** key and click on the virtual model; the model can re-create a starting point. 4. To create a starting point along the vertical or horizontal direction, press the **Shift** key and click on the corresponding position. ## Drawing Figures 1. Draw a figure along the curve of the virtual model. 2. The virtual model can be drawn using the same pattern. 3. Again, click on the starting point to complete a closed figure. ## Working with Flat Boards 1. Select the flat board. 2. Click on the figure that needs to be flat as a board. 3. Press the **Enter** key to remove the board. 4. You can view the generated board in the 2D and 3D windows. ## Adding Background Images 1. In the 2D window background, click the mouse button and select "Add Background Image." 2. Click the Moon button to choose the appropriate image. 3. After selecting the image, click the "Open" button. 4. Click and drag the background image to the model for easier arrangement later. 5. After completion, click "OK." ## Using the Rectangle Tool 1. In the mouse group, select the rectangle tool. 2. Click the 2D window button to view the 2D window. 3. Drag the mouse button to freely arrange the rectangle image as close as possible to the image. 4. Release the mouse button to complete the creation of the image. 5. If the image is blocked, you can choose to hide the texture of the image. ## Creating Straight Lines 1. Use the plus and minus points division tool to create a straight line point at the desired position. 2. Click and hold the left button on the line to generate a straight line point. 3. Use the edit panel tool to adjust the points and lines on the panel. ## Editing Points and Lines 1. Click on the point you want to delete in the selection and delete it with the **Delete** key. 2. Click and drag a straight line to move it to the correct position. 3. Select the tool to edit the curve. 4. Right-click on a straight line and drag it to change it into a curve. The curve created will be displayed as a red dot, which can be adjusted by dragging. ## Adjusting the Panel 1. Use the adjustment panel tool to adjust the entire panel. 2. After clicking on the selected panel, right-click and select "Copy" from the pop-up menu. 3. Right-click again and select "Paste." The copied panel will appear as the mouse moves. 4. You can delete the pasted panel by pressing the **ESC** key. ## Utilizing Smart Guide Lines 1. Right-click and select "Paste" from the pop-up menu to see the smart guide line of the mouse. 2. You can press the **Shift** key to move the mouse in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions. 3. Confirm the motion by releasing the mouse key after placing it in the desired position. ## Final Adjustments and Panel Placement 1. Use the adjustment panel tool to continue adjusting straight lines. 2. While moving the mouse, press **Ctrl** to move it in horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions. 3. Adjust the remaining curve points as necessary. Only when you select the curve point tool can you see the red curve point. ## Creating Points and Patterns 1. After setting up the creation template tool, select the multidirectional tool from the drop-down menu. 2. Click on the creation start point or any point you want to create during the process. 3. You can press the right mouse button to create a point. 4. In the process of creating points, you can also press the right mouse button to create a point and press **Ctrl** + left-click to create a curve. ## Editing and Expanding Lines 1. Click on the starting point to complete the closed pattern. 2. Change to the edit tool. 3. After selecting a line, right-click and select "Expand" from the menu. The selected line will be displayed on the panel. 4. Continue changing to the edit tool and placing the remaining panels as needed. ## Background and Panel Management 1. In the drop-down menu, select "Internal Rectangle." 2. Click on the starting point and left-click to create a curve. 3. After completing the curve, change to the edit tool to place the remaining panels. 4. In the background, right-click and drag the mouse to select a single panel. ## Symmetrical Version Management 1. Click the button and select the symmetrical version, along with the version and sewing line from the menu. 2. A preview of the symmetrical version will appear; click to place it in the correct location. 3. When a version of the symmetrical model is modified, the other version will also change simultaneously. 4. If you wish to cancel the changes, press the **ESC** key. ## Conclusion 1. Arrange the versions in order and then organize them in the 3D window. 2. Click to display the 2D and 3D window buttons to revert to the original window layout. 3. In the 2D background, click and place the 3D window button to finalize your arrangement. This concludes the quick start tutorial on panel creation in Marvelous Designer. Thank you for following along! ```
